description: Source code for the PngBuilder class used to construct and manipulate PNG images within the PDFsharp library, including pixel setting, text storage, and PNG file generation.

classes.name: PngBuilder
classes.description: Class for constructing and encoding PNG images, supporting pixel manipulation, text storage, and compression options.

classes.name: PngBuilder.SaveOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for saving PNG images, including attempt at compression and parallelism.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new PNG builder with specified width, height, and alpha channel presence.

methods.name: FromPng
methods.description: Creates a PNG builder from an existing Png object.

methods.name: FromPngBytes
methods.description: Creates a PNG builder from raw PNG byte array.

methods.name: FromBgra32Pixels
methods.description: Creates a PNG builder from BGRA32 pixel data, width, height, and alpha channel flag.

methods.name: SetPixel
methods.description: Sets pixel color at specified coordinates.

methods.name: StoreText
methods.description: Stores arbitrary UTF-8 text data in PNG's iTXt chunks.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Returns PNG image bytes or writes PNG to a stream with optional save options.
